Unholy Death Knight Rotation Guide - Midnight (Wowhead, by Taeznak, updated 2026/10/13, Patch 12.1.5)
[cache of WebFetch capture 2026-10-28 — used by tools/retail_coverage.py --input rotation=...]

Unholy Death Knight primarily operates based on resources and current procs. This generally means that what we do at any given moment will be based on both of these factors, which makes a typical rotation out of the question, and instead operates on a priority list.

Keep Abilities on Cooldown: Unholy is a very burst-focused specialization, which relies incredibly heavily on using its cooldowns as often as possible to maximize its damage. This makes cooldown setup and execution its highest priority.
Spend your Sudden Doom procs ASAP: Sudden Doom has many interactions with Unholy talents, while also being the strongest non-cooldown button we can press in any scenario. This makes spending this proc with Death Coil or Epidemic as quickly as possible one of the best things you can do.
Keep an eye on your Ghouls: Lesser Ghouls are the bread and butter of Unholy Death Knights in Midnight. So, making sure that you always have stacks of Lesser Ghoul from Festering Strike to allow Scourge Strike to summon them is vital.

Unholy Death Knights' rotational priorities are more often than not, focused on resource management. Between Runes, Runic Power, and our Lesser Ghoul stacks, Unholy has a plethora of resources to manage, and doing so well will drastically improve your DPS.
For all forms of content, Unholy follows a priority list of what spells to cast. Below, we break down the main priority lists for Unholy Death Knights: Single-Target Rotation, AoE Rotation, and your opener sequence.
Hero Talent Master Switches. The Current setting is Rider of the Apocalypse / Sanlayn. Single-Target Priority, AoE Priority, Opener, Pre-Combat Checks.

Best Unholy Death Knight Single Target Rotation (Rider of the Apocalypse)
Unholy in Single Target plays around a priority list, juggling both ability cooldowns and resources based on an order of power. This means with each GCD we go top to bottom on a list, and press the button with the current highest value.
Priority outside of Forbidden Knowledge
1. Cast Outbreak if Virulent Plague is not active.
2. Cast Festering Strike before Dark Transformation if you have 3 or fewer Lesser Ghoul stacks.
3. Cast Soul Reaper if your target has less than 35% health.
4. Cast Blightfall just before your trinket effect ends or about 15 seconds into Dark Transformation, whichever comes first.
5. Cast Army of the Dead on cooldown.
6. Cast Dark Transformation on cooldown.
7. Cast Soul Reaper about 7 seconds after Dark Transformation.
8. Cast Putrefy if Dark Transformation is active.
9. Cast Festering Scythe if its buff is about to expire.
10. Cast Death Coil if you have a Sudden Doom proc.
11. Cast Festering Strike if you have no Lesser Ghoul stacks.
12. Cast Scourge Strike if you have Lesser Ghoul stacks.
13. Cast Death Coil.
Priority during Forbidden Knowledge
1. Cast Soul Reaper if your target has less than 35% health.
2. Cast Blightfall just before your trinket effect ends or about 15 seconds into Dark Transformation, whichever comes first.
3. Cast Soul Reaper about 7 seconds after Dark Transformation.
4. Cast Putrefy on cooldown.
5. Cast Festering Scythe if its buff is about to expire.
6. Cast Necrotic Coil.
7. Cast Festering Strike if you have no Lesser Ghoul stacks.
8. Cast Scourge Strike if you have Lesser Ghoul stacks.
9. Cast Vampiric Strike if you have Lesser Ghoul stacks.

Best Unholy Death Knight AoE Rotation (Rider of the Apocalypse)
Priority Outside of Forbidden Knowledge
1. Cast Outbreak if Virulent Plague is not active.
2. Cast Festering Strike before Dark Transformation if you have 5 or fewer Lesser Ghoul stacks.
3. Cast Blightfall just before your trinket effect ends or about 15 seconds into Dark Transformation, whichever comes first.
4. Cast Army of the Dead on cooldown.
5. Cast Dark Transformation on cooldown.
6. Cast Festering Scythe if its buff is about to expire.
7. Cast Soul Reaper on cooldown.
8. Cast Putrefy if Dark Transformation is active.
9. Cast Death and Decay if you expect your targets to stay inside of it.
10. Cast Epidemic if Sudden Doom procs.
11. Cast Festering Strike if you have no Lesser Ghoul stacks.
12. Cast Scourge Strike if you have Lesser Ghoul stacks.
13. Cast Epidemic.
Priority During Forbidden Knowledge
1. Cast Blightfall just before your trinket effect ends or about 15 seconds into Dark Transformation, whichever comes first.
2. Cast Festering Scythe if its buff is about to expire.
3. Cast Putrefy on cooldown.
4. Cast Death and Decay if you expect your targets to stay inside of it.
5. Cast Soul Reaper on cooldown.
6. Cast Graveyard.
7. Cast Festering Strike if you have no Lesser Ghoul stacks.
8. Cast Scourge Strike if you have Lesser Ghoul stacks.

Best Unholy Death Knight Opener Priority (Rider of the Apocalypse)
Unholy's Opener is fairly notorious for being a "nuclear launch sequence" to get going. This hasn't changed much in Midnight, though the sequences tend to be more simple than before. Potion / On-Use Trinket / Pull.
Sequence
1. Cast Outbreak.
2. Cast Festering Strike.
3. Cast Festering Scythe.
4. Cast Army of the Dead.
5. Cast Dark Transformation
6. Use Combat Potion.
7. Use On-Use Trinket.
8. Cast Putrefy.
9. Cast Necrotic Coil.
10. Cast Necrotic Coil.
11. Cast Vampiric Strike.
12. Cast Vampiric Strike.
13. Cast Necrotic Coil 3 times.
14. Cast Putrefy.
15. Cast Soul Reaper About 7 seconds after Dark Transformation.
Pre-Combat Check
Before entering combat, it is important for Unholy Death Knights to do the following. This applies to raids, dungeons, delves, or even open-world content.
Summon Timmy - Make sure to summon your primary pet (Timmy) by casting Raise Dead.
Hero talent strip: Festering Scythe, Army of the Dead, Blightburst, Soul Reaper, Reaping, Blightfall.

San'layn variants:
Single-Target Priority (San'layn)
Priority outside of Forbidden Knowledge
1. Cast Dark Transformation on cooldown.
2. Cast Putrefy if Dark Transformation is active.
3. Cast Death Coil if you have a Sudden Doom proc.
4. Cast Festering Strike if you have no Lesser Ghoul stacks.
5. Cast Scourge Strike if you have Lesser Ghoul stacks.
6. Cast Death Coil.
Priority during Forbidden Knowledge (San'layn)
1. Cast Putrefy on cooldown.
2. Cast Necrotic Coil.
3. Cast Festering Strike if you have no Lesser Ghoul stacks.
AoE Priority Outside of Forbidden Knowledge (San'layn)
1. Cast Dark Transformation on cooldown.
2. Cast Putrefy if Dark Transformation is active.
3. Cast Death and Decay if you expect your targets to stay inside of it.
4. Cast Epidemic if Sudden Doom procs.
5. Cast Festering Strike if you have no Lesser Ghoul stacks.
6. Cast Scourge Strike if you have Lesser Ghoul stacks.
7. Cast Epidemic.
AoE Priority During Forbidden Knowledge (San'layn)
1. Cast Putrefy on cooldown.
2. Cast Death and Decay if you expect your targets to stay inside of it.
3. Cast Graveyard.
4. Cast Festering Strike if you have no Lesser Ghoul stacks.
5. Cast Scourge Strike if you have Lesser Ghoul stacks.
Opener (San'layn) Sequence
1. Cast Outbreak.
2. Cast Dark Transformation
3. Use Combat Potion.
4. Use On-Use Trinket.
5. Cast Putrefy.
6. Cast Necrotic Coil.
7. Cast Necrotic Coil.
8. Cast Putrefy.
9. Cast Soul Reaper About 7 seconds after Dark Transformation.

Unholy Death Knight Major Cooldowns
Unholy has a few major cooldowns with mechanics that may make you want to use them at specific times. Below, there's a section to go over each of these, explaining when and why you should use them when you do.
Army of the Dead
Army of the Dead is our biggest cooldown and serves as a trigger for many other talents. The most prominent among those would be Raise Abomination, Summon Gargoyle, and Apocalypse Now, where this ability will summon additional pets to fight for us.
With the sheer quantity of pets being summoned by this ability, if you have talented Commander of the Dead, it's vital to ensure that Army of the Dead and Dark Transformation stay in sync, so you are using both at the same time. Generally, this will mean ensuring you hit Dark Transformation as soon as possible after it comes off cooldown once between every Army of the Dead cast.
Dark Transformation
Similar to Army of the Dead, Dark Transformation also triggers several other talents. The most important among these are Commander of the Dead, Outnumber, and Ride or Die!.
With Commander of the Dead, it is particularly important to keep your cooldowns synchronized. With Dark Transformation being an off-global cooldown ability, you can safely macro this into Army of the Dead and only have to worry about a single use between each Army window.
In addition to this, if you talent Outnumber, it becomes incredibly important to try to time your Dark Transformation with add spawns, as the Lesser Ghoul Sweeping Claws attacks are incredibly potent, and will constitute a major portion of our AoE damage potential.
